questions.question:
[지문]
(A) DREAM4 is back! I'm so excited to see my favorite Korean boy band perform. Their singing and their dancing are just perfect. I want to understand their songs without subtitles or translations (a)______. Any tips? - Marisa, 14

(B) You should find friends who are interested (b)in / with DREAM4 and start a club. In my club, we motivate one another. We translate songs and sing together. Doing these things (c)is / are fun and really improves our Korean! - Lori, 15

(C) Follow DREAM4 on social media. They often post short messages in Korean about how they are doing. They also post pictures with the messages, so you can understand the posts more (d)easy / easily. - Aishah, 14

위의 글 (B), (C)의 네모 안에 들어갈 적절한 형태를 고르시오.
(b) / (c) / (d)
questions.explanation:
(b) be interested in: ~에 관심이 있다 (전치사 in 사용)
(c) 주어가 동명사구 'Doing these things'로 단수 취급하므로 is가 적절
(d) 동사 understand를 수식하는 부사 easily가 적절

options: Marisa는 자막 없이 Dream4의 노래를 들을 수 있다.
Dream4는 메시지와 함께 사진도 같이 올린다.

[지문]
(A) DREAM4 is back! I'm so excited to see my favorite Korean boy band perform. Their singing and their dancing are just perfect. I want to understand their songs without subtitles or translations (a)______. Any tips? - Marisa, 14

(B) You should find friends who are interested in DREAM4 and start a club. In my club, we motivate one another. We translate songs and sing together. Doing these things is fun and really improves our Korean! - Lori, 15

(C) Follow DREAM4 on social media. They often post short messages in Korean about how they are doing. They also post pictures with the messages, so you can understand the posts more easily. - Aishah, 14

다음 중 위의 글 (A)~(C) 내용과 일치하는 것은?
questions.explanation: ① DREAM4는 한국 보이밴드이다. ② Marisa는 자막 없이 노래를 이해하고 싶다고 했으므로 아직 이해하지 못한다. ③ Lori의 모임에서는 노래 번역과 함께 노래 부르기도 한다. ④ DREAM4는 소셜미디어에 한국어로 메시지를 올린다. ⑤ 본문에 'They also post pictures with the messages'라고 나와 있으므로 일치한다.

위의 글 (A)에 있는 (a)에 들어갈 적절한 연결어는?
questions.explanation: 'though'는 문장 끝에 위치하여 '그렇지만, 하지만'의 의미로 사용될 수 있다. '자막이나 번역 없이 노래를 이해하고 싶다'는 내용에서 앞 문장과 대조적인 의미를 나타내는 though가 적절하다.

(B) Follow (a)DREAM4 on social media. (b)They often post short (c)messages in Korean about how (d)they are doing. (e)They also post pictures with the messages, so you can understand the posts more easily. - Aishah, 14

위 글 (B)의 (a)~(e) 중 가리키는 대상이 나머지와 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: (a)는 DREAM4라는 그룹 이름 자체를 가리키고, (b), (d), (e)의 They/they는 모두 DREAM4(멤버들)를 가리키며, (c)의 messages는 DREAM4가 올리는 메시지를 가리킨다. (a)만 고유명사로 나머지와 다른 대상이다.

위 글의 (ⓐ), (ⓑ), (ⓒ)에서 어법상 적절한 것끼리 바르게 짝지은 것은?
(ⓐ) / (ⓑ) / (ⓒ)

ⓐ There are hundreds of ~: hundreds of는 복수이므로 are가 적절

ⓒ enjoy는 동명사를 목적어로 취하므로 learning이 적절

questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: Did you make this shelf yourself? It's amazing!
G: _________
B: _________
G: _________
B: _________
G: Thanks. I guess I found a new talent.

<보기>
(A) That's great. I think you're really good at it.
(B) Cool! How do you like it?
(C) It was hard at first, but now I love it. I feel so confident after I finish making something.
(D) Thanks. I started making furniture last year.
questions.explanation: B가 'Did you make this shelf yourself?'라고 묻자, G는 (D) 'Thanks. I started making furniture last year.'로 감사 인사와 함께 시작한 시기를 말합니다. 그러면 B가 (B) 'Cool! How do you like it?'으로 어떤지 묻고, G는 (C) 'It was hard at first, but now I love it.'으로 답하며, B는 (A) 'That's great. I think you're really good at it.'으로 칭찬합니다.

Boy: I'm thinking of taking a swimming class.
Girl: ⑤That's really cool.
questions.explanation: Girl이 'What about you?'라고 물은 뒤 'What do you recommend there?'라고 하는 것은 문맥상 어색합니다. 이 상황에서는 'What would you like to do this year?' 또는 'What do you want to do this year?'라고 묻는 것이 자연스럽습니다. 'What do you recommend there?'는 앞선 대화 흐름과 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 흐름으로 가장 자연스러운 것은?

Somi: Did you make this shelf yourself? It's amazing!
Suho: Thanks. I started making furniture last year.

(A) It was hard at first, but now I love it. I feel so confident after I finish making something.
(B) Exactly. Having new experiences lets us find new talents.
(C) Cool! How do you like it?
(D) That's great. I think you're really good at it.
(E) Thanks. I guess I found a new talent. I think it's good to try new things.
questions.explanation: Suho가 작년부터 가구 만들기를 시작했다고 하면, Somi가 (C) 'Cool! How do you like it?'으로 어떤지 묻고, Suho가 (A) 'It was hard at first, but now I love it.'으로 답하며, Somi가 (D) 'That's great. I think you're really good at it.'으로 칭찬하고, Suho가 (E) 'Thanks. I guess I found a new talent.'으로 감사하며, Somi가 (B) 'Exactly. Having new experiences lets us find new talents.'로 마무리하는 흐름이 자연스럽습니다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 문맥상 단어의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.

Do you want to ⓐ improve your English? I'll give you some tips. First, read a lot of English books. Your vocabulary ⓑ expands through reading. In addition, you can learn many good expressions from the books. Watching a movie without ⓒ subtitles is a good idea, too. Last and most importantly, don't be afraid of speaking English. The grammar doesn't need to be ⓓ incorrect. Just be more ⓔ confident!
questions.explanation: 'The grammar doesn't need to be incorrect(문법이 틀릴 필요는 없다)'는 문맥상 어색합니다. 영어 말하기를 두려워하지 말라는 맥락에서 'The grammar doesn't need to be perfect(문법이 완벽할 필요는 없다)'가 되어야 자연스럽습니다. 따라서 ⓓ incorrect가 적절하지 않습니다.

questions.question:
아래 대화에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 알맞은 위치는?

How did you learn to skateboard?

Ben: Hey, Suji! What are you holding?
Suji: Hi. Ben. It's a skateboard. I'm going skateboarding. (A)
Ben: Wow! I didn't know that you could skateboard. (B)
Suji: I joined a local skateboarding club last month.
Ben: I see. So how do you like it? (C)
Suji: It's really fun (D) It helps me make new friends, too.
Ben: How?
Suji: I go skateboarding with other members of the club, and we share tips with one another (E)
questions.explanation: 'How did you learn to skateboard?(스케이트보드를 어떻게 배웠나요?)'는 Ben이 Suji가 스케이트보드를 탈 수 있다는 것을 몰랐다고 말한 직후인 (B) 위치에 들어가는 것이 가장 자연스럽습니다. 이에 대한 답으로 Suji가 '지난 달 지역 스케이트보드 클럽에 가입했다'고 답하는 흐름이 됩니다.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 요약문에서 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: What are you doing?
G: I'm writing a list of things that I want to do this year.
B: That's nice. What would you like to do this year?
G: Well, first of all, I'd like to spend time volunteering with my friends during summer vacation.
B: That sounds great.
G: What about you? What would you like to do this year?
B: I'm thinking of taking a swimming class.
G: That's really cool.

*(G: Girl, B: Boy)*

What the girl is interested in is ___(A)____, while the boy would like to take ___(B)____.
questions.explanation: 여자아이는 여름방학 동안 봉사활동(volunteering)을 하고 싶다고 했고, 남자아이는 수영 수업(a swimming class)을 받을 생각이라고 했습니다. 따라서 (A)는 volunteering, (B)는 a swimming class가 적절합니다.
